btnProjectsDesc: pick a project with buttons (8 per page) or a recent folder
btnChatsDesc: recent chats in this or all projects: open a chat card and continue it
btnNewDesc: the next message starts a new chat
btnSettingsDesc: permission mode, model and scheduled-task notifications
btnStatusDesc: what's selected and whether a task is running
btnStopDesc: the button under the progress message (or /stop) cancels the task
btnAllowDesc: in the ask and allow edits modes Claude asks before risky actions; answer here or in the app, whichever is first (no answer within 10 minutes means deny)
btnFilesDesc: saved into the project's .claude-desk-uploads folder and passed to Claude with the caption
helpCommands: Slash commands work too: /menu, /projects, /chats, /new, /settings, /status, /stop, /help. Results of scheduled tasks get a "Continue" button that opens that chat in the bot.
notConfigured: Save the bot token and your chat id above first
title: Telegram remote control
warning: Messages to the bot run Claude on this computer with the selected permissions ("allow edits" by default, commands are confirmed with buttons) while Duet is open. The bot only obeys the configured chat id and ignores all other messages and button presses.
helpText: Turn on the switch, open the bot in Telegram and press Start: a menu appears under the input field. Write a task in plain text: Claude runs it as a regular chat in the selected project, live in this app too, while the bot shows the current step and elapsed time with a Stop button, then sends back the answer (long ones also as a .md file).
